signIn.title: Sign in to the console
signIn.description: Use the operator account that manages the companies of this installation.

invitation.title: Create your password
invitation.description: Hi, {{name}}. Choose a password to sign in to the console as {{email}}.
invitation.invalidDescription: This link expired or was already used. Ask another operator for a new link.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Changing the password signs out your other sessions.

validation.slug: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
validation.host: Enter an address such as company.example.com, without http:// or a port.

tenants.title: Companies
tenants.description: Each company has its own database, users, modules and files.
tenants.emptyDescription: Create the first company to get started.

create.title: New company
create.description: The database is created, prepared and installed in the background. Follow the progress on the company page.
create.name: Company name
create.slugHelp: Used in the database name and the file folder. It cannot change later.
create.hostHelp: The domain people will open, already pointing to this server.
create.adminPasswordHelp: Hand the password over through a safe channel; it can be changed later.
create.modulesHelp: Modules required by the template are turned on automatically.
create.startTitle: How would you like to start?
create.startHelp: Choose whether to configure the company now or create a blank instance to configure on first access.
create.blankHelp: Enter only the address. Company and administrator details will be completed in the normal installer when accessing that domain. No template, optional modules or company configuration will be applied now.
create.dependenciesHelp: Dependencies are included automatically. Deselect their parent modules to remove them. Modules can be managed after creation.
create.moduleFallback: Optional capability managed after company creation.
create.dnsHelp: In your domain DNS panel, create a {{recordType}} record for the chosen subdomain pointing to {{ip}}. For company.example.com, use company as its name. Enter the hostname only, without https:// or a path. Wait for DNS propagation. The address must also be configured in the server HTTPS proxy; DNS alone does not publish the company.
create.wildcardTitle: Optional: what is a wildcard domain?
create.wildcardHelp: A {{recordType}} record named * pointing to {{ip}} routes multiple subdomains to the server, such as company1.example.com and company2.example.com. Each address must still be registered to its company and served by the proxy with valid HTTPS. This does not create companies, override explicit DNS records, or cover the root domain or every level of subdomain.
create.serverIpFallback: the server public IP (ask the installation administrator)
create.configureLater: Requires configuration. Configure and enable this capability after creating the company.

tenant.provisioning: The company is being prepared: database, migrations and installation. This can take a few minutes.
tenant.suspendedNotice: The company is suspended: its addresses show an unavailable page and background jobs are stopped.
tenant.suspendDescription: People lose access and background jobs stop. The data is kept.
tenant.deleteDescription: The company database and files are erased. This cannot be undone.
tenant.deleteExport: Write a full copy before deleting
tenant.deleteExportHelp: The copy stays on the server, in the configured export folder.
tenant.hostsDescription: People sign in through the primary address; the others open the company too.

health.title: Health
health.unavailable: No data while the company is not active.
health.noWorkers: No active worker: background jobs are not running.

operators.title: Operators
operators.description: People who sign in to this console and manage the companies.
operators.inviteDescription: The person gets a link to create a password. The link is valid for 7 days.
operators.name: Name
operators.linkDescription: Send this link to {{name}}. It is shown only now.
operators.deactivateDescription: The person is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in to the console anymore.

audit.title: History
audit.description: Everything done in the console and from the command line.

errors.console_sign_in_locked: Too many wrong attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.console_session_required: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.operator_email_taken: An operator already uses this email.
errors.operator_name_invalid: Enter a name of up to 140 characters.
errors.operator_invitation_invalid: This invitation link expired or was already used.
errors.operator_not_invited: This operator already accepted the invitation.
errors.tenant_slug_invalid: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens in the identifier.
errors.tenant_slug_taken: A company already uses this identifier.
errors.tenant_name_invalid: Enter a name of up to 140 characters.
errors.tenant_host_taken: Another company already uses this address.
errors.tenant_host_not_found: This address does not belong to the company.
errors.tenant_last_host: The company needs at least one address.
errors.tenant_status_conflict: The company status changed. Refresh the page.
errors.tenant_deletion_unconfirmed: Type the company identifier to confirm.
errors.configuration_error: This installation cannot write a copy of the company.

features.title: Features
features.description: What this company is allowed to do on its own.
features.pluginManagementHelp: When off, the company's administrators cannot open the Plugins and modules screens or install, enable, disable, configure or remove plugins. Plugins that are already enabled keep working. You can still manage them from here.

plugins.title: Plugins and modules of {{name}}
plugins.description: Install, enable and configure this company's plugins and turn its modules on or off, even when the company cannot do it itself.
plugins.unavailableDescription: Plugins and modules can only be managed while the company is active.
plugins.managementOff: The Plugins and modules screens is turned off for this company. Its administrators cannot change plugins or modules; you can.
plugins.modulesDescription: Disabling a module hides its screens and stops its routines for the whole company. No data is deleted.
plugins.emptyDescription: Upload an .aphelplugin package to install the first one.
plugins.uninstallDescription: The plugin's code, screens and stored values are removed from this company.
plugins.purgeHelp: Deletes the records and fields the plugin created. Without this, they are only hidden and come back if the plugin is installed again.

layout.subline: Create companies, invite operators and follow the installation history.
